d: Darius Acuff Jr. continues to make NBA history with the Sacramento Kings! Through his first 10 career games, Acuff has totaled 259 points and 74 assists, joining Oscar Robertson (1960-61) as the only players in NBA history to record at least 250 points and 70 assists through their first 10 games. Acuff also joins Robertson as the only rookies in Kings franchise history to record multiple 30-point, 10-assist games.
